input.summary: Insert mutual indemnification provisions into Section 9, with HDI covering IP infringement, breach of law, data/Content security incidents and wilful misconduct, and our indemnity limited to Content and Marks we supply.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site, HDI's breach of law, unauthorised access to Content or customer data caused by HDI, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, together with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately narrow (limited to Content and Marks we provide and our own breach of law), and we have placed these provisions in Section 9 so they survive under Section 10.7; if HDI prefers, we can discuss customary IP exclusions and remedies.

ops.text: (c) Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site, or any materials, software, technology or services provided by HDI, infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right (other than to the extent arising from Content or Marks provided by the Company); (2) HDI's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Confidential Information, Content or customer information caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

(d) Indemnification by the Company. The Company shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless HDI from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Content or Marks provided by the Company to HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, or (2) the Company's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation.

(e) Procedure. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnification is sought, and the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of such claim, provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on, or requiring any admission by, the indemnified Party shall be made without its prior written consent. The indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate in the defense with counsel of its own choosing at its own expense.
